name: coder-agents
description: A concise shared setup for AI coding assistants, agnostic of programming languages, agent frameworks, and host tools. Ships one governance manifesto (AGENTS.md) whose spine is the AI-native delivery lifecycle, eight on-demand skills (delivery, execution, quality, architecture, confluence, security-audit, modernize-coding, indexed-search), four routine-task command workflows, two role agents (lead, worker), and deterministic verification gates.
author: bouroo
exampleQueries: Plan this feature through the delivery lifecycle and write the spec and PLAN.md
